description: A lizard man in heavy grey plate armor crouches low on bent legs, shown full figure and facing right. Its scaly head is bright green with a yellowish snout, a small dark eye and a long red forked tongue hanging from its jaws. Its right fist holds a straight silver longsword point-up at the right edge of the picture, and a large round silver shield is strapped to the arm at its back, on the left. A green scaled tail curls up behind its shoulders. The background is a flat teal sky over a band of reddish-brown earth scattered with grey stones. The mood is alert and ready for a fight. Only the tail moves. Frame 1: the tail curves low behind the back. Frame 2: the tail lifts higher. Frame 3: the tail sweeps up into a tall arch, tip curling over. Frame 4: the tail coils back down toward the shoulders. All four frames are equally brief, so the loop reads as a quick, restless lashing of the tail while the body holds still.
title: Armored lizard man lashing its tail
